installCommand.title: Verify Slurm Installation
installCommand.description: Make sure the Slurm client tools are available on the head node.

installCommand.title: Verify Cluster Nodes
installCommand.description: Confirm the compute nodes are visible to the scheduler.

installCommand.title: Install Caladrius Agent
installCommand.description: Run the installer on the head node. It deploys the delegate and the node agents to the compute nodes.
installCommand.command:
curl -fsSL "https://lamintegration.blob.core.windows.net/installers/slurm/install-cluster.sh?<sas-token>" -o /tmp/caladrius-install-cluster.sh && \
ORG_SLUG=da41c956d92 \
CLUSTER=helios \
ENVIRONMENT=production \
REGION=us-east-1 \
DELEGATE_KEY=81a31e55afaf8b8b0eec5e37d57204b4b8cb9354844f28b5b2a3104fb7d4fcec \
COMPUTE_NODES=auto \
SSH_USER=<ssh-user> \
SSH_KEY=<path-to-ssh-private-key> \
ENABLE_BMC=false \
LOKI_PUSH_URL=https://logs.caladrius.ai/loki/api/v1/push \
PROMETHEUS_REMOTE_WRITE_URL=https://metrics.caladrius.ai/api/v1/write \
PROMETHEUS_CA_CRT="<base64-ca-crt>" \
PROMETHEUS_TLS_CRT="<base64-tls-crt>" \
PROMETHEUS_TLS_KEY="<base64-tls-key>" \
ALLOY_CA_CRT="<base64-ca-crt>" \
ALLOY_TLS_CRT="<base64-tls-crt>" \
ALLOY_TLS_KEY="<base64-tls-key>" \
ACR_USERNAME=caladriusacr \
ACR_PASSWORD="<acr-password>" \
bash /tmp/caladrius-install-cluster.sh
